assertions.subject: Cavernous Angioma
assertions.quote: cavernous angiomas also referred to as cavernous malformations (CMs), cavernous hemangiomas, or cavernomas are a type of intracranial vascular malformation with a developmental origin

assertions.subject: Cavernous Angioma
assertions.quote: The terms 'haemangioma' and 'cavernoma' are a misnomer as the lesions are nonneoplastic

assertions.subject: Brain AVM
assertions.quote: The management of brain AVMs depends on the size, location, patient age, and status of the AVM (high risk of rupture)

assertions.subject: Brain AVM
assertions.quote: The most significant risk factor for death is the rupture of the AVM
